notes: First arrival date: 'The Brant arrived 26 August and thereafter. This migration descended upon Izembek Bay in a mass.'
First migration wave. '30 mile long water area in Izembek and Moffet Bay' blanketed with birds. No specific count given.
Major departure observed. 'The Brant lifted from the Bay and departed on a southerly course. The mass of birds was dense enough to appear upon the radar at Cold Bay.'
Residual after first departure: 'found only scattered Brant (perhaps 25 or 30 thousand)'. Midpoint of 25000-30000 range used.
Second migration wave: 'On the fourteenth of October we noted a large increase in Brant concentrations. This second group was not as great as the former.'
Pre-departure staging: 'The first departure was preceded by a massive concentration in and near Applegate Cove (the eastern portion of Izembek Bay) on the 1st of October.'
Second wave departure: text reads '750 were gone by the 20th of November' - likely means 75% (percent sign unclear in typewriter text). Alternatively could be a count of 750 remaining.
All brant departed: 'by the 12th all were gone.' Month uncertain - context suggests late Nov or Dec. Date assigned to Dec 12 but may be Nov 12.
Unusual sighting: 'We noted four flocks in Cold Bay and Kinzarof Lagoon on the ninth of November.' Count is number of flocks, not individuals.
Weight measurement: 'One bird was recorded at 4 pounds 13 ounces. This was the largest we saw.' Plumage records planned for 1951.
